instruction:
Use the ANSYS Workbench GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: one-dimensional steady-state heat conduction.

Model parameters:
- Block 100 mm x 10 mm x 10 mm
- Material: Structural Steel

Boundary conditions:
- Left end face: temperature 100 degC
- Right end face: temperature 20 degC

Analysis type: steady-state thermal analysis

Save requirements:
- Workbench project file: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wb_conduction.wbpj
- The project directory must include thermal analysis results
